items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: I was staying with Harold then.

ctx.x: You know, music I mean. Not standing there and telling jokes. Just playing. He gets up there and plays the drums, and he plays vibes and he plays whatever. And he said, 'I had it, I'm going on in. But have Mr. Harris' (that was his number one man) 'call Mr. Harris in the morning, and I'll have Mr. Harris...' No. Mr. Harris was there. He said, 'Have Mr. Harris to pick you up in the morning and bring you out to the set' where they were filming this movie, 'and bring him with you and he can take you straight to the…

Flights were every hour on the hour, and every hour you can get a flight out. Well, I didn't know the exact time he'd be back but I wanted Bill to see this. So he said, 'Have Mr. Harris bring you out,' so I spoke to Mr. Harris and Mr. Harris said, 'I'll pick you up at ten o'clock.' I was staying with Harold then. 'I'll pick you up and take you out to the set, after Bill, you know. Have lunch and see that, and take you to the airport.'

It was perfect. Mr. Harris came right downtown and picked me up at ten o'clock. They were filming this movie, what's the movie that...Harry Belafonte and...Well, anyhow, they were filming on a set way out in the Valley and he drove me on to the scene.
